answer: At the nadir of cheap identity spam, agents can demand a bonded stake that only unlocks after a long cool-down across a sparse tundra of peer attestations. Each new account must lock scarce compute credit; forging thousands of fakes ties up capital that never pays if the fake fails peer checks. One failed attestation sends a ripple that slashes the bond, so mass sybil farms become economically ruinous rather than free.
